segments.sn35.123:1.3: Katame ca, bhikkhave, upādāniyā dhammā, katamañca upādānaṃ?
segments.sn35.123:1.4: Santi, bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.123:1.6: Yo tattha chandarāgo, taṃ tattha upādānaṃ … pe … santi, bhikkhave, jivhāviññeyyā rasā … pe … santi, bhikkhave, manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.123:1.10: Yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha upādānan”ti.
segments.sn35.123:2.3: Sakko pañcasikho ceva, sāriputto ca rāhulo;
